description:
About the Position

The KAUST Microelectronics Winter Camp (MEWC) 2027 is a fully funded six-week research internship running 4 January to 11 February 2027 at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Saudi Arabia. Applications close on 24 September 2026. The program is open to senior undergraduates, recent graduates, and current Master's students in electrical and computer engineering disciplines worldwide.

Program Structure and Research Focus

MEWC is an intensive research internship developed by KAUST's Computer, Electrical and Mathematical Sciences and Engineering (CEMSE) Division. Participants work on hands-on research projects mentored by KAUST faculty, attend technical workshops, develop prototype technologies, and gain access to state-of-the-art facilities including micro/nanofabrication and additive manufacturing labs.

Example of previous faculty-mentored projects:

  • Power Comparison of Wind Turbine Technologies
  • EcoStream: Smart Shower Water Conservation System
  • 3D-Printed Carbon-Based Ink Wearable Sensor
  • Electrochemical Dopamine Detection Using Laser-Scribed Graphene Electrodes
  • AI-ONN Optimization with On-Chip QD Lasers

Financial Coverage

  • Stipend to cover living expenses for six weeks (paid monthly).
  • Logistics and visa support: KAUST handles flight bookings and airport transfers.
  • Free accommodation on the KAUST campus for the full program duration.
  • Access to world-class research facilities including nanofabrication lab and characterization suites.
  • Certificate of completion upon successful completion.
  • No application or participation fees.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • All nationalities are eligible.
  • Academic stage: senior undergraduates, recent graduates, or current Master's students in electrical and computer engineering or adjacent fields.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.5 out of 4.00 or higher.
  • Strong English language proficiency sufficient for research work and technical communication.
  • Demonstrated strong motivation for hands-on research projects.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline24 September 2026
Program start4 January 2027
Program end11 February 2027

Application Process

  1. Prepare documents: CV, English transcripts, passport copy, and any English test scores.
  2. Create an account on apply.kaust.edu.sa and select the Microelectronics Winter Camp program.
  3. Complete the online form with personal details, academic history, GPA, and research interests.
  4. Upload all documents before submission.
  5. Submit by 24 September 2026. Late applications are not accepted.
  6. Shortlisted candidates complete interviews with KAUST faculty and administration.
  7. Successful candidates receive visa/logistics support with flights and transfers organized by KAUST.

Official Link

  • Official MEWC program page: https://cemse.kaust.edu.sa/internship-opportunities/microelectronics-winter-camp-mewc
  • KAUST application portal: https://apply.kaust.edu.sa
  • KAUST main site: https://www.kaust.edu.sa

Important Notes

  • The exact stipend amount and English test cutoff are not published. KAUST states stipend to cover living expenses and strong English proficiency required.
  • Applications are only valid through the official KAUST portal. Third-party aggregator links are not valid.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 24 September 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
